Name: DMC5 V's Familiars
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
[b]安装说明：[/b]

[list]
[*]将文件解压，拖入 [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]
[/list][list]
[*]你可以找玛尼购买魔宠了。
[/list]
*注意：魔宠语音为DMC5游戏原声。

[list]
[*]因Nightmare的原声恶魔含量过高，不太符合星露谷风格，所以换用它流动的音效。
[/list][list]
[*]众所周知，Griffon“极其健谈”“满口脏话”。既然召唤了他，就得承受被他嘲笑的代价（事实上，我尝试降低他开口的频率，只能说成功了一半。但我尽力了ORZ）。
[/list]
——————————————————————
[b]Installation:[/b]

[list]
[*]Extract the file and drop the folder into [i]Stardew Valley > Mods.[/i]
[/list][list]
[*]You can now purchase the familiars from Marnie.
[/list]
Careful: The familiars voices are taken from the original DMC5 sound effect.

[list]
[*]Nightmare’s original sound carries an intensely demonic quality that clashes with Stardew Valley’s atmosphere, so it has been replaced with the SFX from its flowing state instead. 
[/list][list]
[*]As for Griffon, he is an "extremely talkative" and "foul-mouthed" bird. Summoning him means accepting the cost of being mocked from time to time. (I attempted to reduce the frequency of his voice lines. Well, the result is only partially successful. I did my best X_X
[/list]
